_note: DRAFTVERIFY-IMPL-1111 (plan work/DRAFT-VERIFY-1111, OR-1111-GAPSEARCH). Draft-first, claim-level stance checking and gap-driven acquisition. EVERY STAGE SHIPS OFF: with all stages off no code path of vera.draft_verify, vera.draft_hypothesis, vera.claim_stance or vera.gap_queries runs, no call is made and /ask is byte-identical. Stages: draft_query (one Groq call drafts a short answer whose key terms become a SECOND retrieval query fused by RRF; the draft is never shown and never reaches the writer), stance (one batched Groq-family checker call labels each draft claim against the admitted chunks), gap (silence or discrepancy opens bounded gap rounds in inline_acquire._extra_rounds using the existing routes and gates). Modes: off | shadow (computed and traced as codes and counts only; the answer does not change) | on. A bad value anywhere refuses the whole file (all stages off), never clamps. New stages are Groq-only: they never use the OpenAI checker entry, openai_fallback or the exhaustion grace path, and they skip (fail open to today's pipeline) on exhaustion, a malformed reply or a request-time shortfall.
_comment: WARNING: shadow is NOT a no-op. In shadow the draft and stance stages make REAL Groq calls (draft_hypothesis._real_call, claim_stance._real_call; their results only change nothing visible). Switching any stage to shadow or on is a cost and quota step. The real-call code is untested offline.
_threshold_note: k_chunks, min_contra_docs and num_tolerance are planner priors, UNCALIBRATED (PENDING CAL): no real data yet. They only act when a stage is shadow or on. PDSA cycle 1 (an owner-run pilot with its own deep plan) sets them from the observed spread of at least 60 stratified (claim, chunk) pairs and records the spread here; until then no stage may leave shadow (records/memory/feedback_threshold_calibration_rule.md).
_bounds_note: Structural bounds from plan 2.3 (set by the orchestrator, not decision thresholds). max_claims caps the draft's atomic claims; the rest are dropped.
_family_note: The stance checker must be of a different family from the drafter. If the checker chain falls back to a checker whose family equals drafter_family the result is traced as same_family and may not leave shadow (FM-02).
_reserve_note: Request-time reserve (seconds) kept for the writer and claim check: a draft or stance call is skipped when the remaining request time minus this reserve cannot cover the call's timeout (plan 2.6, FM-09). PENDING CAL; unknown on the streamed path (no deadline), where the call is not skipped for time.
_disconfirm_note: Two seed words added to a discrepancy's disconfirming gap query (plan 2.3). Owner-editable, like config/acq_variants.json; not a threshold.
